---
name: made-to-stick
description: Rewrite any message so it is simple, unexpected, concrete, credible, emotional, and story-driven, following the six principles of sticky ideas. Use when asked to make a pitch, headline, announcement, or explanation more memorable.
---

# Made to stick

## When to use

- Make this pitch more memorable
- Rewrite the announcement so it sticks
- Turn this abstract explanation into a concrete story
- Our headline is forgettable, fix it

## Procedure

1. Find the core message.
2. Apply the six principles in order.
3. Return the rewritten message with one line per principle.
